name: Thomson Reserve
subtitle: Bright Hill Drive · Upper Thomson · District 20

facilities.name: Island Pool
facilities.info: About 1,730 sqm, 1.2m deep. With the infinity lap pool, about 130m of water end to end.

facilities.name: Grand Arrival
facilities.info: Drop-off at Bright Hill Drive, beside Upper Thomson MRT Exit 2.

facilities.name: Paw Garden
facilities.info: Two water points for washing paws.

facilities.name: Grand Function Room
facilities.info: About 97 sqm with an 8.5m ceiling. Induction hob, oven, wine chiller.

facilities.name: Recreation Room
facilities.info: About 64 sqm, with football table, ping pong and darts.

facilities.name: Hydro Spa Pool
facilities.info: Hydro lounger beds and spa seats.

facilities.name: Private Gym
facilities.info: About 29 sqm, with dumbbells and a functional trainer.

island.name: Island Club
island.desc: Resort pools on a landscaped deck one storey up, around blocks 1, 3, 9 and 11.

grand.name: Grand Clubhouse
grand.desc: The social heart: function rooms, gym, the 50m canopy lap pool and the Grand Lawn.

wellness.name: Wellness Club
wellness.desc: Gyms, studios, hydro pools and courts at the Sin Ming Avenue end.

lede: 1,268 homes in six towers on a 5-hectare site raised above Upper Thomson Road, beside Upper Thomson MRT.

factsheet.title: Development
rows: Tamarind Development Pte Ltd, a joint venture of CapitaLand Development, UOL Group and Singapore Land Group
1,268 in 2 blocks of 30 storeys and 4 blocks of 21 storeys
1,021 lots incl. 31 EV and 7 accessible; basement and level 1

factsheet.title: Inside the homes
rows: Smeg in the Classic Collection; Miele in the Luxury Collection, with Liebherr fridges and wine chillers in the 4BR premium and 5BR suites
Digital lockset, smart air-con control for every fan coil, smart home hub
Ducted in 4-bedrooms and above; wall-mounted elsewhere
Electric for 2-bedroom types; town gas for 3-bedroom and above
4BR Premium, 4BR Premium + Study and 5BR Suite (Blk 5 and 7)
